target: Live connected Axomai instructions compared with Open Kitchen Toolkit0.2.0
method: Vendor instruction hashes refreshed live. Prior isolated Codex held-out drafts reused only where hashes match. Toolkit calculations executed through its compiled MCP transport. This compares an instruction-guided host with deterministic tools, not two vendor inference endpoints or a blinded model ranking.

comparisons.result: Toolkit actual MCP output omitted complete serving cost/margin with missing sauce; both the earlier Axomai host trial and toolkit guidance keep incomplete inputs explicit.
Different machine-readable signaling; vendor does not expose additional skill content.

Live connected vendor set is UK-oriented; its separately offered US edition remains untested. Original toolkit profile is explicit and its four-state allergen model retains unknowns. This is a contract difference, not a production safety certification.

limits: No independent Axomai model endpoint is exposed by this connection.
Narrative quality, editing time, subscription ROI and full client installation are not established by arithmetic matches.
No vendor instruction body or proprietary output is redistributed in the public toolkit.
